_about: v1.0 HOLD-OUT pre-registration. Written on 2026-11-24 BEFORE any of these datasets was downloaded or read: expected evidence follows only from each dataset's folder name. The v1.0 rules are developed on the 55 datasets of v10_expected.json only, then frozen (SHA-256 of every rule file recorded in v10_holdout_run.json) and run ONCE on these files; that first run is the result. A dataset counts as detected if at least one expected kind is raised. null = not scored, with the reason.
_selection: every dataset folder in splunk/attack_data whose name starts with azure|aad|o365|m365|aws|gcp|okta|entra|github|gsuite|kube|google, or names an AI service, password spraying or Google Drive, and that no earlier release downloaded

datasets._null_reasons: folders named only 'azuread' / 'azuread_pws' do not say which attack they hold; Falco runtime alerts have no adapter; file-inclusion attacks on a web server are not insider actions
